Amanda's 40 years, in 3 parts. Play through the adventure and see if you can make it to the birthday party!
Four rules, and then the birthday adventure begins.
Every stop is a place from your last forty years. You get two or three choices about what happened there and you pick one.
One choice at each stop is the one that really happened. Press O and the Oracle will point straight at it every time, and she is never wrong.
The bar along the top is the journey. Forty steps takes you all the way to the finish, and three stumbles end it early.
Nothing is lost if you get it wrong. The address bar keeps the whole run, so you can copy the link and walk it again exactly.
